full_description: -----SPANISH------Look for a high flight equal to or greater than x7 in Aviator-Put the time in our App in the first entry-Find the next high change equal to or greater than x7 in Aviator-Put the time in our App in the second entry-Now press "CALCULATE" to get the time of the next 2x in Aviator** Also try to graph your results and help you predict the trend of the game.-----ENGLISH------Look for a high flight equal to or greater than x7 in Aviator-Put the time in our App in the first entry-Look for the next high flight equal to or greater than x7 in Aviator-Put the time in our App in the second entry-Now press "CALCULATE" to get the time of the next 2x in Aviator** Also try graph your results so we can help you predict game tendency.
